prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1465; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the driver's side shows a crushed rear quarter panel, a sprung rear door, and a cracked rear window frame, with scuffing that runs along the lower sill. Most of this damage lines up with the side impact described at the intersection. The repair plan calls for replacing the rear door shell, straightening the quarter panel, and refinishing the affected panels to match. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the records reviewed, and the estimate is recommended for approval.
